entries.columnsContract: `operation_id PK, person_id, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, payload_schema_ref, payload_json, payload_digest, state(preparing|completed|failed), result_schema_ref NULL, result_json NULL, result_digest NULL, failure_code NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`INDEX(state,operation_id)`；用户payload schema为`people.image-operation-request@1`；系统catalogue_registration使用独立`people.catalogue-image-operation-request@1`，固定system actor、稳定Operation/Person ID、目录输入/姓名决定/图片来源摘要与buffalo_l模型，系统分支不得冒充user_upload；用户closed公共字段`schema,operationKind(registration|reference_add|reference_release|reference_replace),expectedPersonRevision,expectedReferenceRevision,operationId,personId,actorId`；registration/reference_add追加`canonicalName,aliases,selectedImage,faceModelRef`，reference_replace再追加`replacedImage`精确旧图/Face快照；reference_release只追加完整`releaseDecision`且不执行import/embedding，≤`16 KiB`并完整JCS digest；registration的person_id为未发布身份的预分配ID；reference_add指向已发布Person并冻结两项expected revision，不能FK或由operation自身当作Person事实；state仅从preparing执行terminal CAS；completed schema固定`people.image-operation-result@1`，closed结果`personId,personRevision,referenceRevision`，≤`16 KiB`；failed保存明确错误码且无result；只有内部工作流及用户本次operation只读查询可见，不构成确认队列

entries.columnsContract: `cycle_id PK, state(active|complete), revision INTEGER, progress_schema_ref, progress_json, progress_digest, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `INDEX(state,cycle_id)`；进度schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-progress@1`，closed字段`schema,policy,stage,sourceCursor,sourceExhausted,pendingSourceId,groupCursor,bestGroup,rankSourceCursor,rankGroupCursor,leaders,windowKey,assignedSinceRank,rankPassId`，最多`16 KiB`并按JCS digest校验；revision CAS；policy固定版本、64组分页及最多五位，不持有Person身份或跨域写权限；stage为source_scan/group_scan/refresh_sources/rank_groups；leaders最多五个有界排名摘要

entries.columnsContract: `cycle_id PK FK, source_id PK, libra_run_id, group_id NULL, observation_schema_ref, observation_json, observation_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(cycle_id,libra_run_id)`；`INDEX(cycle_id,group_id,source_id)`；`FOREIGN KEY(cycle_id) REFERENCES people_us_recommendation_cycles(cycle_id)`；Observation schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-observation@1`，closed字段`schema,source,image,observationDigest`，其中source严格为UsAdultRecommendationSource，image严格为版本化受控图片Evidence；最多`128 KiB`并校验JCS digest；group_id只允许首次分配，不产生影片Actor关系；libra_run_id只是公开来源引用，不创建跨Owner FK

entries.columnsContract: `cycle_id PK FK, group_id PK, representative_source_id, coverage_count INTEGER, quality_score REAL, rank_pass_id NULL, rank_coverage_count INTEGER, rank_representative_source_id NULL, rank_quality_score REAL NULL, revision INTEGER`
entries.constraintsContract: `INDEX(cycle_id,group_id)`；`FOREIGN KEY(cycle_id) REFERENCES people_us_recommendation_cycles(cycle_id)`；来源代表必须由People Owner重验属于同cycle的Observation；coverage为cycle内已归组来源数，rank计数只属于指定版本排名pass重验后的有效来源；清晰度相同时按sourceId稳定选图；revision CAS，禁止把该内部分组当作Person合并

entries.columnsContract: `window_key PK INTEGER, cycle_id FK, revision INTEGER, snapshot_schema_ref, snapshot_json, snapshot_digest, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `FOREIGN KEY(cycle_id) REFERENCES people_us_recommendation_cycles(cycle_id)`；window_key是本维护窗口固定endAtMs；Snapshot schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-publication@1`，closed字段`schema,windowKey,cycleId,policy,items`，items最多五项完整内部Group Snapshot，最多`1 MiB`并校验JCS digest；revision CAS，仅本窗口维护准入可更新尚未生效Publication；GET只读，不能启动扫描或发布

entries.columnsContract: `claim_id PK, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, source_id, active_source_id NULL UNIQUE, state(preparing_person|confirming_source|completed|conflict|person_failed), revision INTEGER, payload_schema_ref, payload_json, payload_digest, person_schema_ref NULL, person_json NULL, person_digest NULL, receipt_schema_ref NULL, receipt_json NULL, receipt_digest NULL, last_failure_code NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`INDEX(state,claim_id)`；active_source_id在活动状态严格等于source_id，终态释放NULL，以单一Owner事务及唯一约束阻止同来源并发认领；payload schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-claim@1`，closed字段`schema,claimId,actorId,recommendationId,publicationWindowKey,publicationRevision,source,imageEvidenceDigest,target`，target为existing精确Person版本或create的preparedRegistration；最多`128 KiB`；person schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-person@1`，closed字段`schema,personId,personRevision,referenceRevision`，最多`16 KiB`；receipt schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-ack@1`，closed字段`schema,receipt:UsAdultActorChoiceReceipt`，最多`16 KiB`；全部JSON按JCS digest校验；请求重放先读持久Claim，revision CAS推进；终态Receipt不因当前推荐变化而重写

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, person_status(active|merged), canonical_name, merged_into_person_id NULL, origin_kind(direct|candidate|catalogue_auto), origin_decision_id, origin_decision_digest, origin_candidate_kind NULL, origin_candidate_id NULL, origin_candidate_revision NULL, origin_candidate_payload_digest NULL, fact_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(person_id,revision)`；immutable；direct为用户Direct Registration，Candidate为Candidate acceptance，catalogue_auto为People系统建档；三者分别保存实际Decision ID/digest，非Candidate列的Candidate引用全NULL；历史direct/candidate语义和行值保持，不能将系统决定伪装成用户；library_kind在Person head冻结且不可改变

entries.columnsContract: `person_id PK FK, decision_id UNIQUE, decision_schema_ref, decision_json, decision_digest, operation_id FK UNIQUE, origin_schema_ref, origin_json, origin_digest, catalogue_input_schema_ref, catalogue_input_json, catalogue_input_digest, name_resolution_schema_ref, name_resolution_json, name_resolution_digest, observation_schema_ref, observation_json, observation_digest, provider_observation_schema_ref, provider_observation_json, provider_observation_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: People-owned immutable系统建档证据；Decision完整canonical副本≤`256 KiB`，origin为closed来源、姓名和图片证明≤`64 KiB`；精确Libra目录输入≤`256 KiB`和People姓名解析≤`64 KiB`都保存完整副本并重算摘要；目录Observation完整canonical副本≤`8 MiB`且digest等于来源Artifact digest；安全Provider Observation完整canonical副本≤`512 KiB`，不持久化URL或Secret；与Person同事务发布，Person保留时精确保留本行及Operation、Reference、系统审计闭包，不反向保留未入藏Libra Subject或视频

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, library_kind(normal|jav|us_adult), provider, namespace, provider_key, provenance_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(person_id,revision,provider,namespace,provider_key)`；`FOREIGN KEY(person_id,revision)`引用精确Person revision；stable identity active unique限定`library_kind,provider,namespace,provider_key`；library_kind必须等于Person head

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, preference_level, reason, origin_kind, origin_ref, committed_at_ms`
`reference_asset_id PK, person_id FK, artifact_handle_id, artifact_digest, state(active|released), created_reference_revision, released_reference_revision NULL, created_at_ms, released_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: stable业务ID由`ReferenceAssetCoordinator`在Plan前分配；`artifact_handle_id/artifact_digest`必须分别等于Decision中`artifactHandle.artifactHandleId/digestHex`；`UNIQUE(person_id,artifact_digest)`；created/released revision都显式引用同Person的`people_reference_revisions`；released不可回到active

entries.columnsContract: `reference_face_id PK, person_id FK, reference_asset_id FK, embedding_handle_id, embedding_digest, model_ref, state(active|released), created_reference_revision, released_reference_revision NULL, created_at_ms, released_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `embedding_handle_id/embedding_digest/model_ref`必须分别等于Decision中`faceEmbeddingSetHandle.artifactHandleId/digestHex/modelRef`；每个active Asset恰好一个active派生Face；Face与Asset同事务建立/释放；`UNIQUE(reference_asset_id)`及`UNIQUE(person_id,embedding_handle_id,model_ref)`；用户API不得按Face ID修改
